channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: MUFG Emut Bank to operate without cash cards
item.description: MUFG Emut will be the first bank affiliated with a major Japanese financial group not to issue cash cards.

item.title: Tokyo police to introduce AI-based accident reconstruction system
item.description: The system will combine AI with 3D spatial data from accident sites and footage from security cameras, reducing the need for on-site inspections.

item.title: Talk of Germany joining GCAP fighter program grows, but Japanese concerns persist
item.description: Officials in Tokyo are worried that adding a new partner at this stage could further delay the aircraft's planned 2035 introduction date.

item.title: Japan unlikely to raise cap for foreign workers despite labor shortages
item.description: Kimi Onoda, minister in charge of policies related to foreign nationals, said demand for a special visa category is expected to eventually decline.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
